rules.naturalLanguage: PSA must be complete for the required ARB stage — sections with placeholder/template language are not acceptable.
rules.evidenceQuote: PSA must be complete for the required ARB stage
rules.remediation: Replace placeholder/TBD text in {section.heading} with completed content before submitting to ARB.

rules.naturalLanguage: Architecture Constraints section must document at least one real dependency with operational context, not template placeholders.
rules.evidenceQuote: Architecture Constraints documented with dependency context
rules.remediation: Document concrete constraints in {section.heading} with dependency, owner and operational impact.

rules.naturalLanguage: Architecture Risks must be meaningful with severity, mitigation and owner — template-only risk tables fail.
rules.evidenceQuote: Architecture Risks include severity, mitigation, owner
rules.remediation: Populate the risk table in {section.heading} with concrete entries (severity + mitigation + owner per row).

rules.naturalLanguage: Decision Records must capture decision, rationale, resolution, owner and status — no template-only records.
rules.evidenceQuote: Decision Records capture decision, rationale, owner, status
rules.remediation: Add decision rationale, options considered, owner and status to each entry in {section.heading}.

rules.naturalLanguage: Technology Standards section must list standards with IDs and align to the approved catalog.
rules.evidenceQuote: Technology Standards listed with IDs and status
rules.remediation: Add explicit standards-catalog IDs/status to {section.heading} (e.g. STD-001 Approved).

rules.naturalLanguage: Design Patterns section must reference the approved enterprise pattern library (DP-### or named patterns).
rules.evidenceQuote: Design Patterns reference approved enterprise pattern library
rules.remediation: Cite specific DP-### patterns from the approved library in {section.heading}.

rules.naturalLanguage: Data Security section must describe controls for data at rest, in transit, and authentication/authorization — not placeholder text.
rules.evidenceQuote: Data Security covers at-rest, in-transit, authentication, authorization
rules.remediation: Complete {section.heading} with concrete controls for at-rest, in-transit, and AuthN/AuthZ.

semanticAnchors.name: at_rest
semanticAnchors.anchorText: encryption at rest customer managed keys

semanticAnchors.name: in_transit
semanticAnchors.anchorText: encryption in transit transport layer security tls

rules.naturalLanguage: Integrations must be documented in detail with source/target, type/schedule, tooling and pattern.
rules.evidenceQuote: Integrations documented with source/target, schedule, tooling, pattern
rules.remediation: Add source/target, type, schedule, and pattern references to each integration in {section.heading}.

rules.naturalLanguage: Infrastructure Architecture must include network/physical design and (when applicable) new IaC modules.
rules.evidenceQuote: Infrastructure Architecture includes network design and IaC modules
rules.remediation: List concrete IaC modules (Terraform/Bicep/ARM) and network design in {section.heading}.

semanticAnchors.name: iac
semanticAnchors.anchorText: infrastructure as code terraform bicep arm

rules.naturalLanguage: Security Architecture must align to internal standards (NIST/PCI/MVS) and include posture, gaps, and traceability.
rules.evidenceQuote: Security Architecture aligns to NIST/PCI/MVS standards
rules.remediation: Reference NIST CSF, PCI DSS or MVS standards alignment in {section.heading}.

rules.naturalLanguage: Information Governance must include data classification/retention and privacy evidence (IG questionnaire/PIA).
rules.evidenceQuote: Information Governance includes PIA / IG questionnaire / data classification
rules.remediation: Attach PIA or IG questionnaire and a data-classification matrix in {section.heading}.

rules.naturalLanguage: DR & Resiliency must document RTO, RPO, and DR design including failover/SLA.
rules.evidenceQuote: DR & Resiliency documents RTO, RPO, and failover design
rules.remediation: State explicit RTO and RPO values plus DR/failover design in {section.heading}.

semanticAnchors.name: rpo
semanticAnchors.anchorText: recovery point objective rpo data loss

semanticAnchors.name: failover
semanticAnchors.anchorText: failover design warm standby hot standby

rules.naturalLanguage: DR section must include at least one business impact scenario or SPOF discussion.
rules.evidenceQuote: DR section discusses business impact / SPOF
rules.remediation: Add at least one business-impact scenario or SPOF discussion to {section.heading}.

rules.naturalLanguage: Design Patterns section must reference at least 3 distinct enterprise patterns.
rules.evidenceQuote: Design Patterns references at least 3 DP-### patterns
rules.remediation: Reference at least 3 distinct DP-### patterns to demonstrate pattern reuse in {section.heading}.

semanticAnchors.name: pattern_count
semanticAnchors.anchorText: multiple patterns dp-001 dp-002 dp-003 dp-004 dp-005

rules.naturalLanguage: Technology Standards section should align with at least one named industry standard (NIST/PCI/ISO 27001/SOC 2).
rules.remediation: Add explicit reference to NIST CSF, PCI DSS, ISO 27001 or SOC 2 in {section.heading}.

semanticAnchors.name: industry_std
semanticAnchors.anchorText: industry standard nist pci iso soc
